text:
## [SECTION 3: Woh Ajeeb Awaz]

Humne gaadi ki raftar dheere karte hue ek khule maidan jaise ilake mein pahunche. Wahan ghane pedon ke beech thodi jagah milti thi. Maine gaadi roki aur kuch palon ke liye wahan ke sannate ko mehsoos kiya. Wo sannata kaan ko chubh raha tha. Gaadi se bahar nikalte hi mujhe zameen par mitti aur sookhe patton ki aawaz sunai di. Tabhi meri nazar thodi door ek purane walkie-talkie par padi. Wo mitti se bhara hua tha aur ghaas ke beech pada tha. Uske metal body ko chune se mujhe ek ajeeb si thandak ka ehsas hua. Aisa lag raha tha jaise woh cheez abhi bhi kisi ka intezar kar rahi ho. Uska antenna toota hua tha aur upar se mitti jami hui thi. Lekin jab maine use pakda toh uski light halki si chamki. Mere dimaan mein sawal utha ki ye device yahan kaise pahuncha, par tabhi kuch aisa hua jisne mere saare sawaal mita diye.

Maine walkie-talkie ka button dabaya aur turant ek bhari static noise shuru ho gayi. Wo shor bilkul kisi purane radio station jaisa lag raha tha. Wo shor itna tez tha ki mujhe apne kaan band karne ka mann kiya. Par main wahin ruka raha. Us shor ke beech se achanak ek awaz ubhri jo mere liye kisi jhatke jaisa tha kyunki wo meri apni hi awaz thi. Maine suna ki koi keh raha hai, "Agar aaj humein kuch nahi mila toh bhi koi baat nahi, bas isi sector ko poora karna hai." Ye wahi sentence tha jo maine subah apne saathi officer Vikram ke saath kabina shuru karte waqt bola tha. Meri dhadkan ek pal ke liye ruk gayi kyunki wo awaz bilkul meri thi. Wo meri hi tone mein aur mere tarah se aa rahi thi. Maine socha ki shayad ye koi recording hai jo galti se chal rahi hai, par uske peeche ka shor itna raw aur real tha ki mujhe yakeen nahi ho raha tha. Meri ungliyan thodi kaanpne lagi aur mera dil zor se dhadakne laga.

Maine dhyan se us device ke display par dekha jo kacchi roshi mein halka sa chamak raha tha. Wahan ek date aur time likha tha jo bilkul aaj ki tareekh aur isi waqt ko darsha raha tha. Ye koi purani recording nahi thi jisne mahino pehle kisi ne record ki ho balki ye kuch second pehle ki baat lag rahi thi. Mera dimaan kaam karna band kar raha tha kyunki agar ye meri awaz hai toh ye abhi kahan se aa rahi hai? Maine dubara us device ko apne kaan ke paas laaya aur dhyaan se suna toh mujhe ek bada farq mehsoos hua. Recording mein meri awaz bilkul shant nahi thi balki wo bahut zyada ghabrayi hui lag rahi thi. Meri awaz mein ek aisa darr tha jo mere chehre par us waqt nahi dikh raha tha. Jaise ki koi mujhe peecha kar raha ho ya main kisi bade khatre se bhag raha hoon. Wo awaz itni desperate thi ki sunne wale ko bhi dar lag jaye aur uski har baat mein ek tadap saaf sunai de rahi thi.

Main thoda aage badha aur apne kaan us walkie-talkie ke speaker par tikha diya taaki main behtar samajh sakun. Jaise hi maine dhyaan se suna, mujhe ehsas hua ki wo awaz koi door se aata hua signal nahi tha. Wo shor jo peeche chal raha tha woh mere aas-paas ke maahol ka hissa lag raha tha. Meri aankhen ghabrahat mein phail gayi jab maine mehsoos kiya ki ye voice note ya recording koi door se transmit nahi ho rahi thi. Wo awaz, meri hi wo tadap bhari baatein aur wo saans phoolne ki aawazein mere theek kuch meter door, un ghani jhadiyon ke peeche se aa rahi thin. Jaise koi wahan chhupa hua ho jo mere hi alfaaz ko dohra raha tha ya shayad woh meri awaz ko capture kar raha tha. Mere badan mein ek jhatka sa laga aur mujhe mehsoos hua ki wo "voice" sirf ek recording nahi thi balki kuch zinda cheez thi. Wo shor ab dheere-dheere kam hone laga aur uski jagh ek gehri khamoshi ne le li jisne mere darr ko aur zyada badha diya kyunki mujhe ehsas ho gaya ki koi wahan maujood hai.
summary: The narrator finds a mud-caked walkie-talkie and hears his own voice from that morning, but in a state of extreme panic. He realizes the recording matches today's date perfectly and, more terrifyingly, the source of the audio is coming from just a few meters away inside the thicket.
